purpose: 2-D cylinder solver-fidelity control (cyl2d_contract.json, frozen 9d53cd1 + formula fix ddc7095; band cyl2d_band.json frozen 5a02b46) on a 16-vCPU CPU worker: R1, R3_domain and M1_mutant. R2 (n_D 64) is NOT in this packet: projected 107-179 h at 2 threads, beyond the worker's lifetime; it is proposed for one H100 separately.
science: model diagnostics; never 'passed'. The cylinder verdict is OUT/eval.json verdict.control_passes, which needs R2 and therefore cannot be true from this packet alone (eval lists R2 as missing). The 3-D C1 sphere reference gate FAILED and stays failed. Nothing here validates fin sections, the fish, swimming or flight.

reference_gate.C1_sphere_3d: FAILED (|Cd| 0.875 at D16 CPU, 0.918/0.881 at D32 GPU, vs band [0.95, 1.35]); blocks physical-validation wording
reference_gate.cyl2d: not yet run; frozen contract + band, evaluator fails closed (a92d80e)

vcpu_plan: 12 Julia threads in total on a shared e2-standard-16 (genomics and glider work share it); 4 vCPUs left for co-tenants, the runner and the OS

measured_local.note: this host, 2 threads; M1 and the RSS figures were measured at load 13-26 on 8 cores, so their ns figures are upper bounds. M1's dt is viscous-limited (nu x4), so it needs ~157k steps, 2.3x R1's
measured_local.thread_scaling: not measurable here: R1 at 1/2/4 threads gave 152/217/119 ns per cell-step at host load 14-19 on 8 cores; the worker's scaling stage measures it

expected.rule: wall = cells x steps x ns_per_cell_step(2 threads) x (2/threads)^0.7. The 0.7 scaling exponent is an ASSUMPTION; the worker's scaling stage measures it. Steps = t_end 600 x n_D / dt, with dt between the start-up value and ~0.6x it (developed wake)

M1_mutant.steps: ~157k (viscous dt 0.122, does not shrink with the wake)

R3_domain.risk: its upper estimate exceeds the 21 h case budget: it may end 'stopped at budget' with a checkpoint, and the packet then reports partial

R2.where: not in this packet: proposed for one H100 (projected 1.1-1.9 h from the 3-D per-step timing, unmeasured in 2-D)

outputs: status.json (completion contract, per-case state/segments/peak RSS, checkpoint sha256)
runs/<id>.json.gz (t, Cd, Cd_p, Cl every step; surface Cp_wall_mean, 720 angles)

numerical: env Manifest sha256 unchanged after instantiate
restart_check: split+resume bit-identical series and final state; foreign checkpoint refused
per run (cyl2d_eval validate): equal-length, finite, strictly increasing t, reaches t_end 600
physical_control (frozen band 5a02b46, a: periodic state: >= 20 whole periods after t = 100 and period CV <= 0.02 in R1, R2, R3
R2_fidelity: R2 Cd, Cd_p, St within 2.0 / 2.1 / 1.3 % of Qu 2013 D4
mutant: M1 (Re 25) must not satisfy the fidelity rule
gates.consequence: without R2 control_passes is false by construction; R1 and R3 are reported against their Qu rows as diagnostics only

export.what: COPS_OUT only: status.json, restart_check.json, scaling.json, runs/*.json.gz, eval.json, logs tails inside status, checkpoints/<id>-<n>.ckpt listed in checkpoints/manifest.json. Never the Julia toolchain, depot, sources or the live WORK checkpoint
export.coherence: a checkpoint is coherent state only if checkpoints/manifest.json lists it with matching sha256 and bytes; *.partial files are in-progress copies and must be skipped
export.bound: checkpoint bytes <= export_bytes_max (2.8 GB) in total, under infra's 3 GB upload cap; mid-run snapshots leave export_reserve_bytes (0.9 GB) free so a stop-at-budget snapshot (R3 ~0.8 GB) always fits; run outputs add ~10-20 MB
export.snapshot_policy: per case: at the first segment end after every export_every_s (6 h), and when the case stops at its budget; none after a case finishes
